ROW.COLUMN: Offsetting transactions or wash trades occur when a purchase and sale of a security occurs either simultaneously or within a short period. This practice may be used to create an artificial impression of activity in a security. From a money laundering perspective, this scheme is important because it can be used to facilitate an anonymous transfer of assets between two parties. This transfer could be accomplished in one of two ways: 1) Two parties may perform trades that are away from the market price for the security involved, causing a gain for one party and a loss for the other. 2) The parties involved could perform offsetting trades to establish opposing positions in a security. In this situation, losses on one side would be offset by corresponding gains on the other. A money launderer may cover the losses for one party, and achieve seemingly clean investment gains in the other party's name. This scenario identifies cases in which two seemingly unrelated parties engage in a pattern of performing offsetting trades with each other.

build 09.21.04.1 - KDS00024486 implemented Functioning of this scenario is based on the system of special temporary tables, filled with data during data ingestion faze. The mail resulting table is OFFSETTING_ACCT_PAIR_STAGE. On this table two datasets are based. The first one (IML_OffsetTr_Prim_Rule) is Primary Rule dataset, which provides data to realize all behavior-detection and alert-generation logic in one place. All supporting values are calculated here too. All Filters, defined in TDS already realized in the table FIRM.OFFSETTING_ACCT_PAIR_STAGE during data ingestion, so there is no constructs for this filters in SQL queries. So dataset provide only the threshold-comparing logic.
The second dataset (IML_OffsetTr_Aux_Trades) is based on OFFSETTING_ACCT_PAIR_STAGE too and provides only data for Trades supporting data.

This practice may be used to create an artificial impression of activity in a security. From a money laundering perspective, this scheme is important because it can be used to facilitate an anonymous transfer of assets between two parties. This transfer could be accomplished in one of two ways: 1) Two parties may perform trades that are away from the market price for the security involved, causing a gain for one party and a loss for the other. 2) The parties involved could perform offsetting trades to establish opposing positions in a security. In this situation, losses on one side would be offset by corresponding gains on the other. A money launderer may cover the losses for one party, and achieve seemingly clean investment gains in the other party's name. This scenario identifies cases in which two seemingly unrelated parties engage in a pattern of performing offsetting trades with each other." focus="CUSTOMER" href="/scenarios/114000052" id="s8" name="(IML/CU) Customers Engaging in Offsetting Trades" scenarioid="114000052" scnroctldid="IML-OffsettingTrade-dINST" shortname="Offsetting Trade"/> <roles> <role format="STRING" highlight="Y" name="Acct_Intrl_Id">Acct =</role> <role format="INTEGER" highlight="Y" name="Tot_Trds_Ct">Tot Trds =</role> <role format="INTEGER" highlight="Y" name="Tot_Offst_Trade_Ct"> Tot Offst Trds = </role> <role format="STRING" highlight="Y" name="Offst_Cust_Intrl_Id"> Offst Cust Id = </role> <role format="STRING" highlight="Y" name="Offst_Acct_Intrl_Id"> Offst Acct = </role> <role format="INTEGER" highlight="Y" name="Occr_Ct">Occurs =</role> <role format="" highlight="N" name="Effctv_Risk_Lvl">Effctv Risk Lvl</role> <role format="" highlight="N" name="CUSTOMER">CUSTOMER</role> </roles> <rule> <row dataset="ds2" norecord="yes"> <comment> Realize all behavior-detection and alert-generation logic in one place </comment> <binding name="Cust_Intrl_Id"> CUST_INTRL_ID<comment> Stores value for CUST_INTRL_ID attribute to be used in Augmentation Instructions for Supporting Data ("Rule Constraints" under "Match Augmentation Rule Editor" ) </comment> </binding> <binding name="Acct_Intrl_Id"> ACCT_INTRL_ID<comment> The Account ID of the account involved in the activity of interest for the focal customer that is the subject of the alert.
